description: Literal cases of packages/eslint-plugin/tests/rules/*.test.ts that the five third-party conformance reports list as divergent under default options, each linted as the only code of one SFC (`mode`: a plain `<script lang="ts">` followed by `export {};`, or `<script setup lang="ts">`). `expected` lists the lines (and, where the report quotes it, the message) typescript-eslint reports; the reports render no-unsafe-argument's backquoted type names as quotes, the oracle keeps the rule's own backquotes. A `blocked` case records what vize reports until the named issue lands.
